en: If there had been no fear of chastisement, then ravens and beasts of prey would have devoured all other animals and men and the clarified butter intended for sacrifices.

sa: स बालस्तेन निष्पिष्टो वेपमानो नृपात्मजः। व्यसुः पपात मेदिन्यां ततो धात्री विचुक्रुशे॥
en: The infant prince trembled greatly as he was being mangled by the tiger and soon fell down dead on the Earth. Seeing in the nurse cried aloud in grief.

sa: आदौ न कुरुते श्रेयः कुशलोऽस्मीति यः पुमान्। स संशयमवाप्नोति यथा सम्प्रतिपत्तिमान्॥
en: Again, a man, who knowing himself as clever, does not seek his own good improper time, is visited by great dangers like the Shakula who had presence of mind.

sa: ते सर्वे तावकान् दृष्ट्वा महेष्वासा: पराङ्मुखान्। नात्यवर्तन्त ते पुत्रं वेलेव मकरालयम्।
en: Beholding your troops turn away from the battle, those great bowmen proceeded against Duryodhana, but they could not overcome him even as the ocean cannot go beyond its continents.

sa: धनानां राक्षसानां च कुबेरमपि चेश्वरम्। पर्वतानां पति मेरुं सरितां च महोदधिम्॥
en: Kubera was made the lord of riches and of all the Rakshasas. Meru was made the king of the mountains, and Oceans was made the lord of the rivers.

sa: मान्धातारं यौवनाश्वं मृतं संजय शुश्रुम। यं देवा मरुतो गर्भ पितुः पार्थादपाहरन्॥
en: Yuvanashva's son Mandhatri also, O Srinjaya, we have heard, met with death. The celestials named Maruts took out that child from his father's stomach through one of its sides.

sa: सर्वेष्वपररात्रेषु याननदन्त बन्दिनः। स्तुतिभिश्च पराया॑भिरुपचारैश्च शिक्षिताः॥ तानिमाः परिदेवन्ति दुःखार्ताः परमाङ्गनाः। कृपणं वृष्णिशार्दूल दुःखशोकार्दिता भृशम्॥
en: Many, whom clever bards formerly used with their hymns and panegyris, to delight every morning, are now surrounded by fair ladies stricken with grief and weeping and crying around them in distress, O foremost of Vrishni's race.

sa: जानामि क्षुधितं दु त्वामाहारसमयश्च ते॥ स त्वं मानभिसंधाय भक्ष्यं मृगयसे पुनः।
en: I know that you are hungry. I know that this is the time of you taking food. You are seeking your prey, and you have your eyes on me.

sa: विस्फुलिङ्गा इव ह्येतान् दहन्ति किल मानवान्। जहीहि मन्यु बुद्ध्या वै धारयात्मानमात्मान॥
en: These tears, like sparks of fire, consume the head for whom they are shed. Drive away your grief with your intelligence, and cheer yourself up with your mental strength.

sa: राज्ञः कोशक्षयादेव जायते बलसंक्षयः॥ कोशं च जनयेद् राजा निर्जलेभ्यो यथा जलम्।
en: Through the decrease of the treasury, the king's army suffers deterioration. The king should, therefore, replenish his treasury like one creating water in a forest which is without water.

sa: भूमिपानां च सर्वेषां बलं बलवतां वरः॥ नान्यः कुन्तीसुतात् कर्णादगृह्णाद् रथिनां रथी।
en: How was that foremost of powerful men, that first of car-warriors, who fought the united force of all the kings in battle, how was he a son of yours?

sa: तद्धेमजालावततं सुघोषं जाज्वल्यमानं निपपात भूमौ॥ तदुत्तमेषून्मथितं विषग्निना प्रदीप्तमर्चिष्मदथो क्षितौप्रियम्। पपात पार्थस्य किरीटमुत्तम् दिवाकरोऽस्तादिव रक्तमण्डलः॥
en: As the sun, in setting, goes down from the Asta Hills with all the lustre so that handsome, brilliant, adorned diadem of Partha came down to the earth smashed to pieces and burning with that snake's poison.

sa: न प्राप्तपूर्वं यद् भीष्मात् कृपद्रोणाच संयुगे। तत् प्राप्तमद्य मे युद्धे सूतपुत्रान्महारथात्॥
en: I had never undergone such humiliation in battle even from Bhishma, Kripa, or Drona, as I have today at the hands of the son of Suta the mighty charioteer.

sa: पालवं पौरवं चैव युवराजं च चेदिपम्। दृष्ट्वा समक्षं निहतं द्रोणपुत्रेण पाण्डवः॥
en: Then beholding the king of the Malavas, the Paurava prince and the youthful ruler of the Chedis slain under his very eyes by the son of Drona, Pandu's son.

sa: सहदेवस्तु संक्रुद्धः खड्गं गृह्य महाहवे। आविध्य प्रासृजत् तूर्णं तव पुत्ररथं प्रति॥
en: Then the highly enraged Shahadeva, after having taken up his sword and turned it round, had hurled it immediately towards the ear of your son in that fierce encounter.

sa: द्रौणेः सकाशमभ्येत्य रोषात् प्रज्वलिताङ्गदः। प्राह वाक्यमसम्भ्रान्तो वीरं शारद्वतीसुतम्॥ दहन्तं पाण्डवानीकं वनमग्निमिवोच्छ्रितम्।
en: (Ghatotkacha), the ornaments of whose arms were falling down from rage, came up to the son of Drona who consuming the Pandava army like a raging forest-fire and fearlessly

sa: छिन्नधन्वा ततो द्रौणिः शक्त्या शक्तिमतां वरः॥ सारथिं पातयामास शैनेयस्य रथा द्रुतम्।
en: When his bow was thus cut-off that hero of heroes, Drona's son, with a dart quickly struck the driver of Satyaki's car down and unseated him from his chariot.

sa: शाकुनिं तु ततः षष्ट्या विव्याध भरतर्षभ। सारथिं त्रिभिरानर्छनं च भूयो व्यविध्यत॥
en: Thereupon, O foremost of the Bharata race, he (Yuyutsu) penetrated Uluka with sixty arrows; and then struck down his driver with three; and he once more pierced him (Uluka).

sa: भूतात्मानं महात्मानमनन्तं विश्वतोमुखम्। अपि देवा न जानन्ति गुह्यमाद्यं जगत्पतिम्॥ नारायणं परं देवं परमात्मानमीश्वरम्। ज्ञानयोनि हरि विष्णुं मुमुक्षूणां परायणम्। परं पुराणं पुरुषं पुराणानां परं च यत्॥
en: Yours is top and undisclosed mystery. You are the foremost cause and supreme lord of this universe. You yourself are supreme god, Narayana, supreme soul (Paramatama) and Ishvara. You yourself are Sri Hari in the form of knowledge, the supreme shelter to the people desirous of emancipation, Vishnu. Gods even are alien to your real form. You yourself are beyond Puranas and supreme Purusha of Purana.

sa: विजित्य पाण्डुपञ्चालान् भारद्वाजः प्रतापवान्। स्वं व्यूह पुनरास्थाय स्थितोऽभवदरिंदमः। न चैनं पाण्डवा युद्धे जेतुमुत्सेहिरे प्रभो॥
en: Then the highly puissant son of Bharadvaja having vanquished the Pandavas and the Panchalas and having reformed his array of troops, stood at its mouth. O master the Pandavas then ventured not to vanquish him in battle.

sa: न शोच्यः पुरुषव्याघ्र यस्तदा निधनं गतः। यत् तु धर्मप्रवृत्तः सन् केशग्रहणमाप्तवान्॥
en: I should not lament for that foremost of men as he had undergone the most excellent from of death. But when fighting fairly, he was seized by the hair.

sa: ससर्ज बाणान् विशिखान् महात्मा वधाय् राजन् कर्णसुतस्य संख्ये। मर्मस्वशङ्कं प्रहसन किरीटी॥
en: Arjuna, the crown holder penetrated his sensitive organs by ten arrows shot on him. He then cut-off his bow with four sharp churas, two arms and the head also.

sa: स्थाणुरुवाच यदि शक्तिर्न वः काचिद् बिभर्तु मामकं बलम्। अहमेतान् हनिष्यामि युष्मत्तेजोऽर्धबृंहितः॥
en: Sthanu said If you have not really got the power of bearing my whole force, then, I, endued with only one half of your united energy, slay them all.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच दैवमेव परं मन्ये धिक् पौरुषमनर्थकम्। यत्र शालप्रतीकाशः कर्णोऽहन्यत संयुगे॥
en: Dhritarashtra said I consider Destiny to be superior and human effort to be fruitless; for the reason that Karna, who was like a Sala tree, was slain in battle.

sa: दुर्लभो विजयस्तेषां संग्रामे रिपुसूदन। याता मृत्युवशं ते वै येषां क्रुद्धोऽसि पाण्डव॥
en: O son of Pandu! You are suppressor of enemy and victory in battle is scarce for those on whom your curse befallen. They have definitely enslaved to the death.

sa: एतावदुक्त्वा यन्तारं ब्राह्मणं परिवर्जयन्॥ स व्यतीयाय यत्रोग्रं कर्णस्य च महद् बलम्।
en: Having thus spoken and avoiding the Brahmana, he advanced addressing his charioteer thus, "Pass through the breach between those two divisions towards the mighty and fierce host of Karna.

sa: तस्मिन् हते महेष्वासे कर्णे युधि किरीटिना। के वीराः पर्यतिष्ठन्त तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय॥
en: When that mighty bowman Karna was slain in battle by the holder of Kiriti (Arjuna), what other heroes were still waiting in the field. Tell me this, O Sanjaya.

sa: यादृशानि हि रूपाणि दृश्यन्तेऽस्य महारणे। अद्य द्रोणं रणे क्रुद्धो घातयिष्यति पार्षतः॥
en: Judging from the appearances of his mighty battle, it may be inferred that filled with rage the son of Prisata will today over-throw in battle the son of Bharadvaja.

sa: निकृष्टयुद्धे द्रोणस्य नान्येषां सन्ति ते शराः। ऋते शारद्वतात् पार्थाद् द्रौणे(कर्तनात् तथा॥
en: Those arrows were only to be used in a fight in close quarters. No one else had arrows of that kind, except Saradvata's son Kripa, Arjuna, Ashvatthaman and Karna.

sa: विराटनगरे चापि समेताः सर्वकौरवाः। पार्थेन निर्जिता युद्धे त्वं च कर्ण सहानुजः॥
en: Again, in the city of Virata, all the assembled Kauravas as well as you, O Karna, together with your younger brother were (all) defeated by Part. a in battle.

sa: जये स्याद् विपुला कीर्ति वः स्वर्ग पराजये। वृषसेन राधेय संक्रुद्धस्तनयस्तव॥ त्वयि मोहं समापन्ने पाण्डवानभिधावति।
en: There is great glory in victory and even in defeat Heaven is certain. O son of Radha, your son Vrisasena, beholding that you are at your wit's end, is advancing towards the Pandavas with great wrath.” to

sa: शोच्येयं भारती सेना राज्यं चैव सुयोधनः। यस्य त्व कर्कशो भ्राता पलायनपरायणः॥
en: Both this army of the Bharatas and king Suyodhana are to be pitied, in asmuch as the latter own you who are now flying away as his brave brother.

sa: समुत्क्षिप्य च तां हृष्टो ननाद बलवद् बली। नादेन सर्वभूतानि त्रासयन्निव भारत॥
en: Wielding that lance that mighty warrior became filled with rage and uttered a loud warcry. And O Bharata, with that war-cry of his, he seemed to frighten all creatures.

sa: तं शरानाददानं च रक्षमाणं च सारथिम्। आत्मानं पालयानं स तावकाः समपूजयन्॥
en: Satyaki flew towards the chariot of Arjuna owning cream-colored steeds. Even your troops then applauded him as they beheld him proceed shooting arrows and protecting himself and his charioteer.

sa: श्रोतारस्तिवदमोह द्रष्टारो वा कुदेशज॥ कर्णवा जघ्नतुः कृष्णौ कर्णो वा निजघान तौ।
en: O you born in a sinful country, people will either see or hear today that either the two Krishnas have slain Karna or Karna has killed the two Krishnas."

sa: जानासि दासार्ह मम व्रतं त्वं यो मां ब्रूयात् कश्चन मानुषेषु। अन्यस्मै त्वं गाण्डिव देहि पार्थ त्वत्तोऽस्त्रैर्वा वीर्यतो वा विशिष्टः॥ हन्यामहं केशव तं प्रसह्य भीमो हन्यात् तूबरकेति चोक्तः। तन्मे राजा प्रोक्तवास्ते समक्षं धनुर्देहीत्यसकृद् वृष्णिवीर॥
en: You know, O Keshava, the best scion of the Dasharha race, that my vow is that whoever among men tells me 'make over, O Partha, your Gandiva to him who is superior to you in point of chivalry or in wielding armours' I will, with all my mighty, slay him. So Bhima also has taken a vow to slay the man who addresses him as 'one without the hirsute indications of manhood!' Just now the king has repeatedly told me in your presence “make over your bow.

sa: एवमेष क्षयो वृत्तस्तावकानां परैः सह। क्रूरो विशसनो घोरो राजन् दुर्मत्रिते तव॥
en: Thus, O monarch, owing to your evil counsels such a ruthless slaughter with cruel onslaught of your champions was brought about as these knights presented arms to your foe.

sa: श्रोतारस्तिवदमोह द्रष्टारो वा कुदेशज॥ कर्णवा जघ्नतुः कृष्णौ कर्णो वा निजघान तौ।
en: O you born in a sinful country, people will either see or hear today that either the two Krishnas have slain Karna or Karna has killed the two Krishnas."

sa: शेतेऽस्माभिनिहता शत्रुसेना छिन्नैर्गात्रैर्भूमितले नदन्ती। त्वया हि तत् कर्म कृत् नृशंसं यस्माद् दोष: कौरवाणां वधश्च॥
en: Lo, the hostile troops, slain by us are lying prostrate on earth with mangled limbs and are uttering the deepest groans. Indeed, it was you who didst those wrongs, for which the Kauravas have lost their lives.

sa: । ततः प्रववृते युद्धं व्यतिषक्तरथद्विपम्। तावकानां परैः सार्धं राजन् दुर्मन्त्रिते तव॥
en: Then, O monarch there ensued a furious encounter, the result of our evil policy, in which the infantry, cars and elephants of your party encountered those of the other.

sa: न तेषां मतिपूर्वं हि सुकृतं दृश्यते क्वचित्। दुष्कृतं तव वा वीर बुद्ध्या हीनं कुरूद्वह॥
en: (It does not seem) that they (i.e., the Pandavas) have done anything good by reason of superior intellect; nor (does it appear) O hero, O perpetuator of Kuru-race you have done anything wrong through want of understanding.

sa: आददानं महेष्वासं संदधानं च सायकम्॥ विसृजन्तं च कौन्तेयं नानुपश्याम वै तदा।
en: We then could not discern when that mighty bowmen, that son of Pandu begotten upon Kunti, took out his shafts, placed them on the bow-string and let them off.

sa: निकृत्या वञ्चिताः पार्था विषयोगैश्च भारत। दग्धा जतुगृहे चापि द्यूतेन च पराजिताः॥
en: We beguiled the sons of Pritha by deceit as well as by administration of poison, O Bharata. They were (again) burnt in the lac house and defeated at dice.

sa: उपदिष्टो वधोपायः कर्णस्य गुरुणा स्वयम्। व्यायच्छतश्च खड्ड्रेन द्विधा खङ्गं चकार ह॥
en: Karna was informed of the means of Abhimanyu's death by the preceptor himself. While Abhimanyu was fighting with his sword, it was Drona who cut-off that sword in twain.

sa: पश्य सैन्यानि वार्ष्णेय द्राव्यमाणानि कौरवैः। द्रोणकर्णी तु संयत्तौ पश्य युद्धे महारथौ॥
en: Behold, O scion of the Vrishni race, my troops routed by the Kouravas! Behold the two mighty car-warriors, Drona and Karna fight, yonder, to the best of their abilities.

sa: द्रोणोऽपि समरे राजन् माधवस्य महद् धनुः। अर्धचन्द्रेण चिच्छेद रथशक्त्वा च सारथिम्॥
en: In that battle Drona also, O king, with a crescent-shaped arrow cut-off the mighty bow of that descendant of Madhava; and he smote the latter's driver with a lance.

sa: या ह्यस्य परमा शक्तिर्जयस्य च परायणम्। सा शक्तिर्वासुदेवेन व्यंसिता च घटोत्कचे॥
en: That Sakti which was such a powerful weapon and on which rested his hopes of victory, also even that Sakti had been made futile by Vasudeva's son through Ghatotkacha.

sa: अनासाद्य तु शैनेयं सा शक्तिः कालसंनिभा। भित्त्वा रथं जगामोग्रा धरणी दारुणस्वना॥
en: That lance resembling the Destroyer himself, without reaching the grandson of Sini, penetrated through his chariot and then fell on the ground, looking fierce and emitting a loud noise.

sa: एष हि ब्राह्मणद्वेषी यज्ञद्वेषी च राक्षसः। धर्मस्य लोप्ता पापात्मा तस्मादेष निपातितः॥
en: This Rakshasa was a contumner of the Brahmanas and a destroyer of sacrifices; this wicked-souled one inimical to the performance of sacrifices and therefore has he been slain thus.

sa: स जित्वा समरे शत्रून् द्रोणपुत्रो महारथः॥ ननाद सुमहानादं तपान्ते जलदो यथा।
en: Having defeated his enemies in battle, that mighty car-warrior, the son of Drona, began to send forth thundering roars like those of the clouds at the end of summer.

sa: तस्यार्जुनः शरैः षड्भिर्गीवां पादौ भुजौ शिरः। निचकर्त स संछिन्नः पपातादिचयो यथा॥
en: Of him, with six shafts, Arjuna cut-off the neck, the two legs, his arms and his head; and thus cut to pieces, he fell down like fragments of rocks.

sa: यथा सर्वास्ववस्थासु वार्ष्णेयः पाति पाण्डवम्। तथा भवान् परित्रातुं कर्ण वैकर्तनं रणे॥
en: Even as that descendant of the Vrishni race protects the son of Pandu in all his vicissitudes, so do you guard Karna the son of Vikartana, in the battle.

sa: संजय उवाच घटोत्कचं यदा कर्णो न विशेषयते नृप। ततः प्रादुश्चकारोग्रमस्रमस्रविदां वरः॥
en: Sanjaya said When, o king, Ghatotkacha, that foremost of all wielders of weapons, found that could get no advantage over Karna he invoked into existence an exceedingly fierce weapon.

sa: या प्रीतिधर्मराजे मे भीमे च बलिनां वरे। नकुले सहदेवे च सा मे त्वयि शलाग्रज॥
en: Arjuna said O eldest brother of Shalya, the love I bear for you is equal even to that I bear for king Yudhishthira the virtuous or Bhima that foremost of all mighty persons or Nakula or Sahadeva.

sa: अद्य दुर्योधनो राज्याजीविताच निराशकः। भविष्यति हते कर्णे कृष्ण सत्यं ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: Most assuredly do I tell you, O Krishna, the Karna's doom being (thus) sealed today, Duryodhana, goaded to desperation will lose all hope of both his life and sovereignty.

sa: अवमानमहं प्राप्य न योत्स्यामि कथञ्चन। आपृच्छे त्वाद्य गान्धारे गमिष्यामि गृहाय वै॥
en: Thus having obtained this insult I will never battle in the field, O son of Gandhari, today. I ask your permission, as I am really willing to return home.

sa: स्थघोषेण महता नादयन् वसुधातलम्। पर्जन्य इव धर्मान्ते नादयन् वै दिशो दश॥
en: Ringing the surface of the earth with the thundering rattle of his car like the roar of the clouds at the end of summer, that king of kings, Yudhishthira.

sa: तवैष भागः समरे राजमध्ये मया कृतः। तवैवानुमते वीरं तं विक्रम्य निबर्हय॥
en: Amongst all my kindly allies, I have allotted this (Rakshasa Ghatotkacha), with your permission as your share in battle. O hero, do you bring him down displaying your prowess.

sa: हयाभ्यां च गजाभ्यां च रथाभ्यां च पदातिभिः॥ युयुधाते महामायौ राक्षसप्रवरौ युधि।
en: Riding on the back of elephants or horses or on their chariots, those foremost of Rakshasas both possessed of potent illusive powers, fought with each other in that battle.

sa: संजय उवाच एवमुक्त महाराज सर्वे कौरवपुङ्गवाः। न स्म किंचिदभाषन्त मनसा समपूजयन्॥
en: Sanjaya said After Satyaki had said these words, none amongst the Pandavas and the Kauravas, o king, said anything; on the other hand they praised Bhurisravas in their mind.

sa: तं च शब्दमसह्य वै तस्याः संलक्ष्य मारिष। प्रापतन्मनुजास्तत्र रथेभ्यो रथिनस्तदा॥ ते हन्यमाना भीमेन गदाहस्तेन तावकाः। प्राद्रवन्त रणे भीता व्याघ्रघ्राता मृगा इव।॥ सतान् विद्राव्य कौन्तेयः संख्येऽमित्रान् दुरासदान्। सुपर्ण इव वेगेन पक्षिराडत्यगाचमूम्॥ तथा तु विप्रकुर्वाणं रथयूथपयथूपम्। भारद्वाजो महाराज भीमसेनं समभ्ययात्॥ भीमं तु समरे द्रोणो वारयित्वा शररोर्मिभिः।
en: At the unbearable sound of that mace, O sire men began to fall down on the spot they stood; and many car-warriors dropped down from their cars. Slaughtered by Bhima armed with a mace in his hands, your troops began to fly away terrified from the field of battle, like deer attacked by a tiger. The son of Kunti then causing his brave adversaries to fly away, passed through that division with great force, like Suparna, that king of birds. While Bhima that leader of leaders of car hosts was thus spreading carnage in your troops. O mighty monarch, the son of Bharadvaja, viz., Drona rushed upon Bhima, checking the latter with his showers of arrows.

sa: अद्याहमनृणः कृष्ण भविष्यामि धनुर्भृताम्॥ कोपस्य च कुरूणां च शराणां गाण्डिवस्य च।
en: O Krishna, I will acquit myself, today, of the obligations I owe to all the bowmen, to my avenging spirit, to the Kurus, to my shafts and to Gandiva.

sa: ततो मयः स्वतपसा चक्रे धीमान् पुराणि च। त्रीणि काञ्चनमेकं वै रौप्यं कार्णायसं तथा॥ ते
en: Thereupon Maya, who was of superior intelligence, constructed the three cities with the help of his own asceticism, the one of the three was inade of gold, the second of silver and the third of black iron.

sa: पुत्राणामिव चैतेषां धर्ममाचरतां सदा। दुह्येत् को नु नरो लोके मदन्यो ब्राह्मणब्रुवः॥
en: Is there, in the world, any other Brahmana besides myself that would injure the (Pandavas) who devoted to righteousness and are (as dear) to me as my (own) sons.

sa: विच्छिन्नानि तथा राजन् बलान्यासन् विशाम्पते। तद् बलं भरतश्रेष्ठ वव्यमानं तदा निशि॥
en: So, O ruler of men, your troops were then routed and dispersed by Arjuna. O foremost of the Bharatas, then the troops of your army carnaged during that night.

sa: तस्य मे संशयं छिन्धि दुःखपारं तितीर्षतः। कुरुणां सृञ्जयानां च के च जीवन्ति के मृताः॥
en: Do you now remove all by doubts, who are most willing to bridge over this ocean of sorrow, by relating to me, who amongst the Kurus and the Pandavas are yet alive and who are already dead.

sa: ततः सुतास्ते वरुणात्मजोपमा रुषान्विताः सह गुरुणा महात्मना। वृकोदरं सरथपदातिकुञ्जरा युयुत्सवो भृशमभिपर्यवारयन्॥
en: Then your sons resembling those of Varuna filled with wrath and eager for battle led by (their) high-souled preceptor surrounded on all sides Vrikodara by cars foot-soldiers and clephants.

sa: एतदिच्छामि तत्त्वेन व्याख्यातुं वै पितामह। सूक्ष्मा गतिर्हि धर्मस्य यत्र मुह्यन्ति मानवाः॥
en: O grandfather, I wish to hear this explained to me in full. The course of duty is highly subtile. Men are often seen to be stupefied about that course.

sa: पिता चैव जनित्री च श्रान्तौ वृत्तसोत्सवाविव॥ अप्रभुत्वे स्थितौ वृद्धावन्नं प्रार्थयतः सुतान्।
en: Fathers and mothers are tired with work, and do not enjoy festivities. Aged parents having no power over sons, have been compelled to beg their food of the latter.

sa: उदक्यामासते ये च द्विजाः केचिदनग्नयः। होमं चाश्रोत्रियं येषां ते सर्वे पापकर्मिणः॥
en: Those Brahmanas who know women in their season, or who never celebrate sacrifices, or whose families have no members well-read in the Vedas, are considered as Shudras in act.

sa: हार्योऽयं विषयो ब्रह्मन् गान्धर्वो नाम नामतः। छन्दतो वर्ततां विप्र यथा वदति वा भवान्॥ अतिथिः पूजनीयस्त्वमिदं च भवतो गृहम्। सर्वमाज्ञाप्यतामाशु परवन्तो वयं त्वयि॥
en: This music and dance, especially known by the name of Gandharva, is a stealer of the heart (and of time), Act as you like, or let this go on if that be your pleasure. You are my guest and, therefore, worthy of worship. This is your house. Do you set your commands. We are all bound to you.

sa: तस्याहमभवं पुत्रो धौम्यश्चापि ममानुजः॥ कस्यचित् त्वथ कालस्य धौम्येन सह माधव। आगच्छमाश्रमं क्रीडन् मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम्॥
en: I was born as the son of that Rishi and Dhaumya was born as my younger brother. On a certain occasion, O Madhava, accompanied by Dhaumya, I arrived at the hermitage of certain Rishi of purified souls.

sa: आदित्योऽयं स्थितो मूढाः स्नेहं कुरुत मा भयम्। बहुरूपो मुहूर्तश्च जीवेदपि कदाचन॥
en: There the Sun still shines in the sky, ye fools! Give vent to your feelings, fearlessly! Many are the virtues of the hour. This child may regain its life.

sa: चिरं मञ्चत बाष्पं च चिरं स्नेहेन पश्यत। एवंविधानि हीष्टानि दुस्त्यजानि विशेषतः॥
en: Do you shed tears for him for some time, and look at him a little longer with affection. It is difficult to cast off objects which are so dear.

sa: अवज्ञातः सुखं शेते इह चामुत्र चाभयम्। विमुक्तः सर्वदोषेभ्यो योऽवमन्ता स बध्यते॥
en: He who is freed from all shortcomings sleeps fearlessly both here and hereafter even if insulted by others, On the other hand, he who insults him, meets with destruction.

sa: वेदेषु निष्ठां सम्प्राप्य साङ्गेष्वपि तपस्विनः। अथोचुस्ते तदा व्यासं शिष्याः प्राञ्जलयो गुरुम्॥
en: All of them had perfectly mastered the Vedas with their branches. All of them were observant of penances. With joined hands they addressed their preceptor in the following words.

sa: निग्रहेण च पापानां साधूनां प्रग्रहेण च। इयं तपस्विनी सत्या धारयिष्यति मेदिनी॥
en: I shall perform this task by punishing the wicked and supporting the righteous. The Earth, which is the embodiment of Truth, will succeed in bearing her burden of creatures.

sa: यथाकृता च भूतेषु प्राप्यते सुखदुःखिता। गृहीत्वा जायते जन्तुर्दुःखानि च सुखानि च॥
en: Amongst creatures, the measure of happiness or misery depends on pristine deeds. Every creature is born in the world, taking with him his own measure of happiness and misery.

sa: ये ते रात्र्यहनी पूर्व कीर्तिते जीवलौकिके। तयोः संख्याय वर्षाग्रं ब्राह्मे वक्ष्याम्यहःक्षपे॥
en: Calculating by the days and nights of human beings about which I have told you, I shall speak of the day and night of Brahman and his years also.

sa: किं करिष्यथ शोचित्वा मृतं किमनुशोचथ। सर्वस्य हि प्रभुः कालो धर्मतः समदर्शनः॥
en: Of what use is mourning? Why do you grieve for the dead? Time is the master of all, and he by his very nature looks impartially on all things.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच तुष्यसि त्वं स्वधर्मेण तथा तुष्टा वयं नृप। अन्योन्यस्यान्तरं नास्ति यदिष्टं तत् समाचर॥
en: The Brahmana said You are content with the observance of the duties of your order. Likewise, I am content with the duties of mine, O king. there is, therefore, little difference between us. Do what you please.

sa: नायं परस्य सुकृतं दुष्कृतं चापि सेवते। करोति यादृशं कर्म तादृशं प्रतिपद्यते॥
en: One never has to enjoy or endure the good and bad deeds of another. Indeed, one enjoys and endures the fruits of only those acts that he does oneself.

sa: पापं कृतं न स्मरतीह मूढो विवर्तमानस्य तदेति कर्तुः। राहुयथा चन्द्रमुपैति चापि तथाबुधं पापमुपैति कर्म॥
en: A man shorn of understanding never thinks of the sins committed by him. Those sins, however, overtake the doer who has disregarded the scriptures. As Rahu comes to Chandra, those sinful acts come to the foolish man.

sa: चक्षुषा मनसा वाचा कर्मणा च चतुर्विधम्। कुरुते यादृशं कर्म तादृशं प्रतिपद्यते॥
en: This opinion is wrong. In sooth, one acquires the fruits of whatever among the four sorts of acts one does with the eye, the mind, the tongue, and muscles.

sa: अथेमं दर्शनोपायं सम्यग् यो वेत्ति मानवः। सम्यक् स्वधर्मं कृत्वेह परत्र सुखमश्नुते॥
en: That man who is well conversant with the means of acquiring Liberation and who duly satisfies the duties of his order, certainly acquires great happiness in the next world.

sa: भीष्म उवाच इत्युक्तो भृगुणा राजन् भरद्वाजः प्रतापवान्। भृगुं परमधर्मात्मा विस्मितः प्रत्यपूजयत्॥
en: Bhishma said Thus, O king, did Bhrigu speak the highly energetic Bharadwaja. Of highly virtuous soul the latter became filled with wonder and adored the great sage with veneration.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच फलप्राप्तिं न जानामि दत्तं यज्जपितं मया। अयं धर्मश्च कालश्च यमो मृत्युश्च साक्षिणः॥
en: The Brahmana said I have no knowledge of the fruits I have acquired. I have, however, given you those fruits that I have acquired by recitation. These, viz., Dharma and time and Yama, and Mrityu, are witnesses.

sa: इतिहासस्य कर्ता च पुत्रस्ते जगतो हितः। भविष्यति महेन्द्रस्य दयितः स महामुनिः॥
en: He shall, besides, be the author of the ancient histories and do behoof to the world, Gifted with severe penances he shall, again be the dear friend of Shakra.

sa: नास्ति विद्यासमं चक्षुर्नास्ति सत्यसमं तपः। नास्ति रागसमं दुःखं नास्ति त्यागसमं सुखम्॥
en: There is no eye like that of knowledge. There is no penance like the practice of truth. There is no sorrow like attachment. There is no happiness like renunciation.

sa: सम्भावयन्ति पितरं त्वया सम्भाविताः खगाः। असंशयं पिता वै त्वं पुत्रानाहूय जाजले॥
en: There, those birds, treated affectionately by you, are showing their love for you who are their father! Forsooth, you are their father, O Jajali! Do you call your children!

sa: पञ्चभूतसमुद्भूतं लोकं यश्चानुपश्यति। तथा च वर्तते दृष्ट्वा लोकेऽस्मिन् मुक्त एव सः॥
en: That man who considers this world as the result of the combination of the five principal elements, and who acts in this world, keeping this notion foremost, is liberated.

sa: धूतपाप्मा तु तेजस्वी लध्वाहारो जितेन्द्रियः। कामक्रोधौ वशे कृत्वा निनीषेद् ब्रह्मणः पदम्॥
en: Purged of all sins, gifted with energy, sparing in diet, with senses under complete control, one should, after having subdued his desire and anger, try to attain to Brahima.

sa: दानेन तपसा चैव सत्येन च युधिष्ठि। ये धर्ममनुवर्तन्ते ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those men, O Yudhishthira, who perform the duties laid down in the scriptures for them, practising the virtues of charity self control and truthfulness, go to the celestial region.

sa: न हि त्वां प्रस्थितं कश्चित् पृष्ठतोऽनुगमिष्यति। सुकृतं दुष्कृतं च त्वां यास्यन्तमनुयास्यति॥
en: When you shall go along that road, nobody will follow you. Only your deeds, good and bad, will follow you when you shall leave his world for the next.

sa: मुक्ता वीतभया लोके चरन्ति सुखिनो नराः। सक्तभावा विनश्यन्ति नरास्तत्र न संशयः॥
en: Those persons who live in this world shorn of attachments and fear, succeed in acquiring happiness. Those persons, however, who are attached to worldly objects, forsooth, meet with destruction,

sa: आकाशस्था ध्रुवं यत्र दोषं ब्रूयुर्विपश्चिताम्। आत्मपूजाभिकामो वै को वसेत् तत्र पण्डितः॥
en: What learned man who cares for his respect will live there where people talk about the faults of the learned even when such have no foundations to stand upon?

sa: महतः परमव्यक्तमव्यक्तात् परतोऽमृतम्। अमृतान्न परं किंचित् सा काष्ठा सा परा गतिः॥
en: Superior to Mahat is the Prakriti. Superior to the Prakriti is Brahma. There is nothing superior to Brahma. That is the highest limit of goodness and the highest end.

sa: ज्ञाने ह्येवं प्रवृत्तिः स्यात् कार्याणामविशेषतः। यत् कार्यं न व्यवस्यामस्तद् भवान् वक्तुमर्हति॥
en: We do not know our duties, for the injunctions of the scriptures create inclination for Knowledge simultaneously with the inclination for acts. You should describe these subject to us.

sa: शुक उवाच अकरोद् यच्छरीरेषु कथं तदुपलक्षयेत्। इन्द्रियाणि गुणाः केचित् कथं तानुपलक्षयेत्॥
en: How can one understand that unequal distribution in the various objects of the universe? Which amongst them are the senses and which the attributes? How may this be understood?

sa: यो ह्येतद् ब्राह्मणो नित्यं शृणुयाद् धारयेत वा। न तस्याध्ययनं नाशमुपगच्छेत् कदाचन॥
en: That person who frequently listens or mentally recites this history of the assumption by Narayana of the form with the horse-head, will never forget his Vedic or other learning.

sa: उपक्रमानहं वेद पुनरेव फलोदयान्। लोके फलानि चित्राणि ततो न विमना ह्यहम्॥
en: I know also what the commencement of acts is in this world, what, of their fruits and how different are those fruits. Hence I never give way to sorrow.

sa: तव शाखा महाशाख स्कन्धांश्च विपुलांस्तथा। न वै प्रभग्नान् पश्यामि मारुतेन कथंचन॥
en: Your branches, O wide-branched king of the forest, are lofty and majestic as huge is your trunk! I never see any of them broken by the god of wind.

sa: तदहं बुद्धिमास्थाय भयं मोक्ष्ये समीरणात्। यदि तां बुद्धिमास्थाय तिष्ठेयुः पर्णिनो वने॥
en: If the other trees in the forest all depend upon the same kind of intelligence, then, no injury can come to them from the Wind-god when he is irate.

sa: अहं हयशिरा भूत्वा समुद्रे पश्चिमोत्तरे॥ पिबामि सुहुतं हव्यं कव्यं च श्रद्धयान्वितम्।
en: Becoming the Equine-head I pass through the Western and the Northern ocean and drink sacrificial libations duly poured with Mantras and solid sacrificial food offered with respect and devotion.

sa: क्षेत्रं जानाति चाव्यक्त क्षेत्रज्ञ इति चोच्यते। आव्यक्तिके पुरे शेते पुरुषश्चेति कथ्यते॥
en: And because, He knows that Unmanifest Kshetra, He is, therefore, also called Kshetrajna. And because also Soul enters into Unmanifest Kshetra (viz., the body), therefore is He called Purusha.

sa: एवं त्विह स सर्वत्र प्राणेन परिचाल्यते। पृष्ठतस्तु समानेन स्वां स्वां गतिमुपाश्रितः॥
en: Thus Prana makes the living creature move about and exert. Then by virtue of the other vital air called Samana, every one of the senses performs its own work.

sa: न हि वैरं महात्मानो विवृण्वन्त्यपकारिषु। शनैः शनैर्महाराज दर्शयन्ति स्म ते बलम्॥
en: Even when gifted with equal might, people do not suddenly create enmities with those who have injured them. On the other hand, they show their power gradually, O king.

sa: राजोवाच दीयमानं न गृह्णासि ऋणं कस्मात् त्वमद्य वै। यथैव तेऽभ्यनुज्ञातं तथा गृह्णीष्व मा चिरम्॥
en: The king said, Why do you not accept payment that is sought lo be made for the debt that he owes to you? Do not delay, but accept payment of what you know, to be your due!

sa: ततो दिवं भुवं खं च जगच्च सचराचरम्। ददाह पावको राजन् भगवत्कोपसम्भवः॥
en: Indeed, that fire begotten of the Divine Lord's anger, O king, burnt Heaven and Earth and the Sky and the whole Universe with all its mobile and immobile beings.

sa: सौतिरुवाच एतत् तु महदाख्यानं श्रुत्वा पार्थिवसत्तमः। ततो यज्ञसमाप्यर्थं क्रियाः सर्वाः समारभत्॥
en: Sauti said Having heard this great discourse, that best of kings began all those rites that are laid down in the ordinance, for the completion of his great sacrifice.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अतिक्रामति कालेऽस्मिन् सर्वभूतभयावहे। किं श्रेयः प्रतिपद्येत तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह।१।।
en: Yudhishthira said Time, which is a terror to all creatures, is rolling on. What is that source of good for which one should try? Tell me this, O grandfather.

sa: प्रीत्या यशो भवेन्मुख्यमप्रीत्या परमं भयम्। प्रीत्या ह्यमृतवद् विप्राः क्रुद्धाश्चैव विषं यथा।॥
en: If they be pleased, you will win high fame. If otherwise, great will be your fear. If pleased, the Brahmanas become like ambrosia. If enraged, they become like poison.

sa: एवं त्वक्चक्षुषी जिह्वा नासिका चेति पञ्चमी। स्पर्श रूपे रसे गन्धे तानि चेतो मनश्च तत्॥
en: The same is the case with the skin, the eyes, the tongue, and the nose forming the fifth. They exist in touch, form, taste, and smell. They form the faculty of perception and they are the mind.

sa: स तत्र भगवान देवः पुष्करे भ्राजयन् दिशः। ब्रह्मा समभवत् तात् सर्वभूतपितामहः॥
en: Then, O son the illustrious and divine Brahman, the Grandfather of all creatures, came into being from that lotus, lighting all the points of the horizon with his effulgence.

sa: राजोवाच धिग्राजधर्मं यस्यायं कार्यस्येह विनिश्चयः। इत्यर्थं मे ग्रहीतव्यं कथं तुल्यं भवेदिति॥
en: Fie on royal duties, the fixed action of which is even such! I should, however, take what you give only for making the two sorts of duty exactly equal.

sa: ताभ्यो विश्वानि भूतानि देवाः पितृगणास्तथा। गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्चैव रक्षांसि विविधानि च॥ पतत्रिमृगमीनाश्च प्लवङ्गाश्च महोरगाः। तथा पक्षिगणाः सर्वे जलस्थलविचारिणः॥ उद्भिदः स्वेदजाश्चैव साण्डजाश्च जरायुजाः। जज्ञे तात जगत्सर्वं तथा स्थावरजङ्गमम्॥
en: From them originated all the creatures of the universe, including the gods, Pitris, Gandharvas, Apsaras all sorts of Rakshasas, birds, animals, fishes, monkeys, great snakes, and various species of fowl ranging in the air or the water and vegetables, and all oviparous or viviparous being or those or born of filth. In this wise the whole universe consisting of mobile and immobile creatures came into being.

sa: ततोऽलातेन दीप्तेन विश्वस्तं निजघान तम्। निहत्य च मुदा युक्तः सोऽनुबन्धनं दृष्टवान्॥
en: With the help of that blazing fire he killed the trustful bird, and having killed him, became filled with joy, never thinking there was sin in what he did.

sa: जले निलिल्यिरे काश्चित् काश्चिद् गुल्मान् प्रपेदिरे।।२९ वसनान्याददुः काश्चित् तं दृष्ट्वा मुनिसत्तमम्।
en: Some of them, to hide their nakedness, plunged into the river, and some entered the groves hard by, and some quickly took up their clothes, at seeing the Rishi.

sa: नास्ति विद्यासमं चक्षुर्नास्ति सत्यसमं तपः। नास्ति रागसमं दुःखं नास्ति त्यागसमं सुखम्॥
en: There is no eye which is equal to that of knowledge. There is no penance like Truth. There is no sorrow like Attachment. There is no happiness like Renunciation.

sa: तत्र देवाः प्रयच्छन्ति राज्यानि च धनानि च। शुभैः कर्मभिरारब्धाः प्रच्छिन्दन्त्यशुभेषु च॥
en: There the gods seemed to be engaged in granting kingdoms and riches to men, induced by their good deeds, and in taking them away when men deviated from goodness.

sa: त्याग एव हि सर्वेषां युक्तानामपि कर्मणाम्। नित्यं मिथ्याविनीतानां क्लेशो दुःखवहो मतः॥
en: Renunciation of acts is (laid down) for all persons who seek Liberation earnestly. They, however, who have not been instructed correctly have to bear a heavy load of sorrow,

sa: स चाद्य दिवस: पुण्यो ह्यतिथिश्चायमागतः। संकल्पितं चैव धनं किं विचार्यमतः परम्॥
en: This is a sacred day. Gautama has come here as a guest. The wealth that is to be given away is ready. What is there then to think of.

sa: वदन्ति कारणं चेदं सांख्याः सम्यग् द्विजातयः। विज्ञायेह गती: सर्वा विरक्तो विषयेषु यः॥ उर्ध्वं स देहात् सुव्यक्तं विमुच्येदिति नान्यथा। एतदाहुमहाप्राज्ञाः सांख्ये वै मोक्षदर्शनम्॥
en: Those twice-born ones, again, who are believers in the Sankhya doctrines forward good reasons for showing that a person by acquiring true knowledge of all objects, becomes dissociated from all earthly objects, and, after death, it is plain, becomes liberated and that it cannot be otherwise. Men of great wisdom have thus expounded the Sankhya philosophy of Liberation.

sa: अतिथिरुवाच अहमप्यत्र मुह्यामि ममाप्येष मनोरथः। न च संनिश्चयं यामि बहुद्वारे त्रिविष्टपे॥
en: The Guest said I also am confounded about this subject. The same thought occupies my mind. I am unable to arrive at certainty of conclusion. Heaven has many doors.

sa: अधर्मतां याति धर्मो यात्यधर्मश्च धर्मताम्। वधो नाम भवेद् धर्मो नैतद् भवितुमर्हति॥
en: Sometimes virtue assumes the form of sin, and sin assumes the form of virtue. It can never be possible that destruction of individuals can ever be a virtuous act.

sa: न शक्यं द्रष्टुमन्येन वर्जयित्वा पिनाकिनम्। सुदर्शनं भवत्येवं भवेनोक्तं तदा तु तत्॥
en: On account of its blazing energy it was incapable of being looked at by and person except the holder of Pinaka. It was, therefore, that Bhava named it Sudarshanam.

sa: अल्पकश्च यथा राजन् वह्निः शाम्यति दुर्बलः। आक्रान्त इन्धनैः स्थूलैस्तद्वद् योगोऽबलः प्रभो॥
en: A small and weak fire, O king, is put out when large logs of timber are placed upon it. So the Yogin who is weak, O king, encounters ruin.

sa: भद्रे निवेष्टुकामं मां विद्धि सत्येन वै शपे॥ विषयेष्वनभिज्ञोऽहं धर्मार्थं किल संततिः।
en: I am an utter stranger to enjoyments of every kind. O blessed lady, know that I have become desirous of marriage for getting children. I swear by truth itself.

sa: यथोक्तमेतत् तव सर्वमीप्सितं नरेन्द्र कर्ता नचिरात् तु वानरः। शरत्प्रतीक्षः क्षमतामिमं भवान् जलप्रपातं रिपुनिग्रहे धृतः॥
en: O lord of men, I fully approve of all you had said. The monkey-chief shall soon engage in our service. Resolved on the destruction of your enemy, do you spend here this rainy season awaiting the autumn.

sa: हिरण्यनाभ शैलेन्द्र परितुष्टोऽस्मि ते भृशम्। अभयं ते प्रयच्छामि गच्छ सौम्य यथासुखम्॥
en: Greatly delighted am I, O lord of mountains, O you having golden peaks. 'No fear' I do declare to you. Proceedest you therefore, at your ease, O gently one!

sa: सुप्तायास्ते गमिष्यन्ति नव वर्णाणि पञ्च च। समग्रमिह सम्प्राप्तं मां द्रक्ष्यसि सुहद्वतम्॥
en: You will find these five and nine years pass away as if in a sleep. Then again, getting me, you will see me surrounded by my friends and relatives.

sa: ततोऽहं मानयामि त्वां मान्योऽसि मम मारुते। त्वया ममैष सम्बन्धः कपिमुख्य महागुणः॥
en: I shall therefore adore you and you are object of my worship O Maruta! And this my relation with you, O foremost of monkeys, is pregnant with many virtues.

sa: एवं मन्ये गुणवतां गुणानां फलमुच्यते। पित्रा मात्रा च यत्साधुर्वीरो निर्वास्यते वनम्॥
en: The virtuous and heroic Rāma is being banished by his father and, mother Even this methinks will be asserted as the fruit of the virtues possessed by the pious.

sa: बद्धस्त्वं कालपाशेन क्व गतस्तस्य मोक्षसे। वधाय बडिशं गृह्य सामिषं जलजो यथा॥
en: You have been bound up by the noose of Death; and, proceeding whither, shall you save yourself, like to fish eating up baits with hooks for their own destruction?

sa: दूरेऽपि निवसन्तं त्वां मानसेनाग्रतः स्थितम्। चिन्तयन्तोऽद्य नूनं त्वां निराहाराः कृताः प्रजाः॥
en: Thinking in their minds that you although actually at a great distance from them, are before them, the subjects (not finding you) will renounce food (and thus destroy themselves.)

sa: तव मातुरसग्राहं विद्म पूर्वं यथा श्रुतम्। पितुस्ते वरदः कश्चिद् ददौ वरमनुत्तमम्॥
en: I remember what I have heard from old men concerning the vicious inclinations of your mother. Some one intent upon conferring boons conferred an excellent one on your father.

sa: मया विसृष्टां भरतो महीमिमां सशैलखण्डां सपुरोपकाननाम्। शिवासु सीमास्वनुशास्तु केवलं त्वया यदुक्तं नृपते तथास्तु तत्॥
en: Staying at the auspicious frontiers, let Bharata barely rule this earth furnished with watery expanses, cities and forests, when it has been renounced by me. O king, let what you have said be as you wish it.

sa: न चैतन्मे प्रियं पुत्र शपे सत्येन राघव। छत्रया चलितस्त्वस्मि स्त्रिया भस्माग्निकल्पया॥ वञ्चना या तु लब्धा मे तां त्वं निस्तर्तुमिच्छसि। अनया वृत्तसादिन्या कैकेय्याभिप्रचोदितः॥
en: But, O Raghava, I swear to you, this is anything but agreeable to me, my son. I have been made to swerve from my purpose by the crafty Kaikeyi resembling a fire hidden under ashes. You are going to give effect to the deceit that has been practised upon me by this woman intent upon sullying her line.

sa: पुनः प्राप्ते वसन्ते तु पूर्णः संवत्सरोऽभवत्। प्रसवार्थं गतो यष्टुं हयमेधेन वीर्यवान्॥
en: When after a full one year, spring had again appeared on the face of the earth, the puissant king, intent upon getting offspring through the horse-sacrifice, sough Vasistha's side.

sa: संतुष्टः प्रददौ तस्मै राक्षसाय वरं प्रभुः। नानाविधेभ्यो भूतेभ्यो भयं नान्यत्र मानुषात्॥
en: And propitiated by his penances, the Master conferred a boon on the Raksasa to the effect, that, save man, no fear should come to him from the various beings.

sa: अवज्ञाताः पुरा तेन वरदाने हि मानवाः। एवं पितामहात् तस्माद् वरदानेन गर्वितः॥
en: And in the matter of that boon-bestowing, man had formerly been disregarded (by Ravana). And puffed up with pride in consequence of the boon he received from the Grand-sire.

sa: न त्वहं मनसा त्वन्यं द्रष्टास्मि त्वदृतेऽनघ। त्वया राघव गच्छेयं यथान्या कुलपांसनी॥
en: I have not, like one bringing stigma on her line, ever in my life thought of a second person, but of you whom I must follow into the forest.

sa: यदि मां दुःखितामेवं वनं नेतुं न चेच्छसि। विषमग्नि जलं वाहमास्थास्ये मृत्युकारणात्॥
en: If you do not purpose to take me with you, surely will I do away with my life by drinking poison, entering into fire, or drowning myself in water.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु सुग्रीवो रामं वचनमब्रवीत्॥ प्रनष्टा श्रीश्च कीर्तिश्च कपिराज्यं च शाश्वतम्। त्वत्प्रसादान्महाबाहो पुनः प्राप्तमिदं मया॥
en: Thus addressed, Sugrīva said to Räma, O mighty-armed one, my lost luck, and repute, and the entire monkey kingdom I have received back through your gift, owing to thine and your brother's grace, you foremost of victors.

sa: शुभक्षेत्रगतश्चाहं तव संदर्शनात् प्रभो। ब्रूहि यत् प्रार्थितं तुभ्यं कार्यमागमनं प्रति ॥
en: O lord, by beholding you, surely my body has been rendered pure. Tell me, what is it that you would have, and what is the purpose of your coming?

sa: अभिप्रेतमसंसक्तमात्मजं दातुमर्हसि॥ दशरात्रं हि यज्ञस्य रामं राजीवलोचनम्। नात्येति कालो यज्ञस्य यथायं मम राघव॥ तथा कुरुष्व भद्रं ते मा च शोके मनः कृथाः।
en: Even this is my wish, and he also has come of age. Do you, therefore, part with your son, the lotus-eyed Rāma, for the ten days of the sacrifice! Do you act so, O descendant of Raghu, that the time appointed for the ceremony may not be overpassed. Good betide you! Let not your mind indulge in grief!

sa: काष्ठान्यानीय भग्नानि काले शुष्कानि कुञ्जरैः॥ धक्ष्यामस्त्वां वयं वीर श्वभ्रे महति कल्पिते।
en: O, hero, we shall burn you after collecting all the branches that have been broken down by the elephants and dried up in time, and digging a big trench.

sa: न चिरात् तं वधिष्यामि रावणं निशितैः शरैः। पौलोम्याः पितरं दृप्तं शतक्रतुरिवारिहा॥
en: That Rāvana I will at no distant date slay with my sharpened shafts, even as that slayer of enemies, he of an hundred sacrifices-slew the haughty father of Paulomi.

sa: तम्यर्षेः परमोदारं वचः श्रुत्वा नरोत्तमौ। स्नात्वा कृतोदकौ वीरौ जेपतुः परमं जपम्॥
en: Hearing those proper words of the ascetic, those foremost of men, endowed with heroism, bathed, and, sipping water, began to recite the Gayatri. (The solar hymn of the Veda).

sa: यक्षिण्या घोरया राम उत्सादितमसह्यया। एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं यथैतद् दारुणं वनम्। यक्ष्या चोत्सादितं सर्वमद्यापि न निवर्तते॥
en: O Rāma, by the dreadful and unbearable Yakşiņi. And now I have related to you all about this fearful forest. And to this day none is capable of letting that Yakşiņi from committing ravages right an left.

sa: विष्णुना च पुरा राम भृगुपत्नी पतिव्रता। अनिन्द्रं लोकमिच्छन्ती काव्यमाता निषूदिता ॥
en: And formerly, O Rama, Visnu destroyed Kāvya's mother, the devoted wife of Bhrgu, who had set her heart upon annihilating the world, deprived of sleep (through fear of her.)

sa: मूलमर्थस्य संरक्ष्यमेव कार्यविदां नयः। मूले हि सति सिध्यन्ति गुणाः सर्वे फलोदयाः॥
en: The root of any work must be preserved. This is the policy of those versed in business. The root existing, all the virtues, obtaining fruit, certainly meet with success.

sa: अहं प्रभावसम्पन्ना स्वच्छन्दबलगामिनी। चिराय भव भर्ता मे सीतया किं करिष्यसि ॥
en: I am endued with power, and range about at will by virtue of my strength. Become my husband for ever and a day. What will you do with Sita?

sa: इत्युक्त्वा लक्ष्मणं चाशु लाघवं दर्शयन्निव। विगृह्य सुमहच्चास्त्रमाग्नेयं रघुनन्दनः॥ सुबाहूरसि चिक्षेप स विद्धः प्रापतद् भूवि। शेषान् वायव्यमादाय निजघान महायशाः। राघवः परमोदारो मुनीनां मुदमावहन्॥
en: Having said this, anon showing to Lakşmaņa his lightness of hand, Raghu's descendant took out a mighty Āgneya weapon, and discharged it at the breast of Subāhu. Thereat being pierced with that shaft, he fell down upon the ground. Then taking a Vāyavya weapon, the illustrious and exceedingly generous Rāghava, bringing delight to those ascetics, slew the rest.

sa: सर्वथा तु न गन्तव्यमीदृशः क्व गमिष्यसि। देशकालौ प्रतीक्षस्व पक्षौ त्वं प्रतिपत्स्यसे॥
en: Do not by any means go hence; and in this case, whither, again, wilt you repair? Do you stay here for season and place. You shall regain your wings.

sa: यथाख्यातमगस्त्येन मुनिना भावितात्मना। १ इयं गोदावरी रम्या पुष्पितैस्तरुभिर्वृता॥ हंसकारण्डवाकीर्णा चक्रवाकोपशोभिता। नातिदूरे स चासन्ने मृगयूथनिपीडिता॥
en: And, as told by that pure-hearted ascetic, Agastya, this is the graceful Godåvarī, bordered by flowering trees; swarming with swans and Kārandavas, delighted with Cakravākas, thronged with herds of deer,* not far, yet not so very near.

sa: सोऽहं वाससहायस्ते भविष्यामि यदीच्छसि। सीतां च तात रक्षिष्ये त्वयि याते सलक्ष्मणे॥
en: If you will, I shall become your help during your abode (in the woods). And, O child, I shall protect Sītā when you shall go out along with Laksimana.

sa: नाराजके जनपदे माल्यमोदकदक्षिणाः। देवताभ्यर्चनार्थाय कल्प्यन्ते नियतैर्जनैः॥ नाराजके जनपदे चन्दनागुरुरुषिताः। राजपुत्रा विराजन्ते वसन्ते इव शाखिनः॥
en: In a kingless country, persons with intent hearts do not offer garlands, sweets, and Daksinās, for worshipping the gods. In a kingless country princes smeared with sandal and aguru, do not look graceful like trees in spring.

sa: शोकाभिभूते रामे तु शोकार्ते शरणं गते। कर्तुमर्हति सुग्रीवः प्रसादं सह यूथपैः॥
en: On Rāma being overwhelmed with sorrow, tried by grief, and having come under his refuge,' it behoveth Sugrīva along with the leaders of bands to show favour to Rāma?

sa: न तं पश्याम्यहं लोके परोक्षमपि यो नरः। स्वमित्रोऽपि निरस्तोऽपि योऽस्य दोषमुदाहरेत्॥
en: I do not find any such man in this world, even amongst great enemies, who, forsaken for heinous sins, can cite, even in his absence, any fault of him.

sa: प्लवमानं तु तं दृष्ट्वा सिंहिका नाम राक्षसी॥ मनसा चिन्तयामास प्रवृद्धा कामरूपिणी।
en: And it came to pass that beholding him in the act of bounding, a Rākşasi named Sinhikā, of great age, and capable of wearing forms at will, thought herself.

sa: बभूव पश्यन्मनसोऽप्रियाणि यान्यन्यदा नास्य पुरे बभूवुः। अवाक्शिरा दीनमना न हृष्टः पितुर्महात्मा प्रविवेश वेश्म ॥
en: And witnessing many unpleasant things which he had never seen during the life of the monarch, that high-souled one entered the mansion of his father, bending his head, depressed in spirits, and with his mind extremely aggrieved.

sa: ततः कृतोदकं स्नातं तं गृधं हरियूथपाः। उपविष्टा गिरौ रम्ये परिवार्य समन्ततः॥
en: When the vulture had offered oblations of water to the manes of his deceased brother and finished his ablutions, the monkey-chiefs sat down in that charming mountain, surrounding him.

sa: कुतोऽभिलषणं स्त्रीणां परेषां धर्मनाशनम्। तव नास्ति मनुष्येन्द्र न चाभूत् ते कदाचन ॥ मनस्यपि तथा राम न चैतद् विद्यते क्वचित्। स्वदारनिरतश्चैव नित्यमेव नृपात्मज ॥ धर्मिष्ठः सत्यसंधश्च पितुर्निर्देशकारकः। त्वयि धर्मश्च सत्यं च त्वयि सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम्॥
en: Nor yet, O foremost of men, can you ever even in fancy be (guilty of) going after others' wives, which destroy all religious merit. These, O Rāma, are by no means in you. O King's son, you ever and a day direct your attentions to own wife. And you are Righteous and truthful and do the will of your şire. In you are established virtue and truth, and every thing; and by help of your conquered senses, you, O mighty armed one, are capable of bearing everything.

sa: स्वागतं ते रघुश्रेष्ठ राम सत्यभृतां वर। आश्रमोऽयं त्वयाऽऽक्रान्तः सनाथ इव साम्प्रतम॥
en: Welcome, you foremost of the Raghus, O Rāma, you the best of those practising righteousness. This asylum now has been furnished with its master in consequence of your visit.

sa: समयं च ममार्येमं यदि त्वं न करिष्यसि। अग्रतस्ते परित्यक्ता परित्यक्ष्यामि जीवितम्॥
en: If you did not fulfil this noble vow, O worshipful Lord, you have made to me, forsaken by you will I even in your very presence renounce my life.

sa: कौसल्या च सुमित्रा च याश्चान्या मम मातरः। दुःखेन महताविष्टास्त्वां प्राप्य कुलदूषिणीम्॥
en: O slayer of your husband! it is because of you, stainer of your race, that Kausalyā, Sumiträ, and other mothers of mine have been overwhelmed with a mighty sorrow.

sa: ततः प्रियतरो नास्ति मम प्राणाद् विशेषतः। कृतापराधो बहुशो मम बन्धुभविष्यति ॥
en: He shall be dearer to me than life itself, and none dearer (to me) that he; and although he might commit innumerable wrongs, still should he become my friend.

sa: सा विस्फुरन्ती परिरभ्यमाणा भर्तुः समीपादपनीयमाना। ददर्श राम शरचापपाणिं स्वतेजसा सूर्यमिव ज्वलन्तम्॥
en: And snatched away from her husband and trembling, she beheld Rāma, with bow and arrows in his hand burning like to the Sun by virtue of his own effulgence.

sa: नालं द्वितीयं वचनं पुत्रो मां प्रतिभाषितुम्। स वनं प्रव्रजेत्युक्तो बाढमित्येव वक्ष्यति॥
en: My son is incapable of uttering a second word to me; and commissioned, he will repair to the words saying., 'Very well.' If ordered with 'Go to the forest.

sa: हतोऽहं पुरुषव्याघ्र शक्रतुल्यबलेन वै। मया तु पूर्वं त्वं मोहान ज्ञातः पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: Slain am I, O chief of men, by you possessed of strength equal to that of Śakra. Through ignorance, O foremost of men, I could not before know you.

sa: यज्ञोपसदनं ब्रह्मन् प्राप्तोऽसि मुनिभिः सह। द्वादशाहं तु ब्रह्मर्षे दीक्षामाहुर्मनीषिणः॥ ततो भागार्थिनो देवान् द्रष्टुमर्हसि कौशिक।
en: Twelve days, O Brahmarși, have been fixed for the period of initiation by the sages. On the expiry of that term, you will, O Kausika, behold the celestials come to the sacrifice for claiming their respective shares.

sa: मया विरहिता बाला रक्षसां भक्षणाय वै। सार्थेनेव परित्यक्ता भक्षिता बहुबान्धवा ॥
en: Alas! did I leave her alone only to be devoured by the Rākşasas? And she has been eaten up like one weak and helpless albeit she has many friends.

sa: व्यथितो विक्लवश्चैव व्याघ्रीं दृष्ट्वा यथा मृगः। असंवृतायामासीनो जगत्यां दीर्घमुच्छ्वसन्॥ मण्डले पन्नगो रुद्धो मन्त्रैरिव महाविषः। अहो धिगिति सामर्षों वाचमुक्त्वा नराधिपः॥ मोहमापेदिवान् भूयः शोकोपहतचेतनः।
en: And pained and woebegone, like to a deer at the sight of a tigress, he fetched a deep sigh, and sat down on the uncovered ground. Like a venomous snake confined by power of incantation within a circle, the lord of men, in indignation exclaimed. “O fie!" And deprived of his senses by grief, he again swooned away.

sa: स तु दृष्ट्वा रुदन् दीनः पपात धरणीतले। उत्थाप्यमानः शक्रस्य यन्त्रध्वज इवोच्छ्रितः॥
en: And seeing this, he exceedingly distressed, crying fell down to the ground. And raised up (by others) he looked like an uplifted banner of Sakra bound to an engine.

sa: स विसृष्टो बलवता बाणः स्वर्णपरिष्कृतः। भित्वा सालान् गिरिप्रस्थं सप्तभूमिं विवेश ह॥
en: The arrow, clear as the gold itself, hurled by that one of mighty strength, perforating the trees, entered into the mountainous expanse and the sevenfold regions of the earth.

sa: कच्चिद् बलेषु कोशेषु मित्रेषु च परंतप। कुशलं ते नरव्याघ्र पुत्रपौत्रे तथानघ॥
en: And O repressor of foes, is it well with you as to, O most powerful of men, your forces; exchequer, and friends, and, O sinless one, sons and grandsons?'

sa: यौ तौ देवासुरे युद्धे वरौ दशरथो ददौ। तौ स्मारय महाभागे सोऽर्थो न त्वा क्रमेदति॥
en: Do you, O exalted dame, bring into Daśaratha's recollection the two boons which he had granted you at the time of the war between the gods and Asuras, and you shall not fail to achieve your objects.

sa: यद्धि मात्रा कृतं पापं नाहं तदपि रोचये। इहस्थो वनदुर्गस्थं नमस्यामि कृताञ्जलिः॥
en: I do not at all relish the sin that has been committed by mother. Remaining here with joined hands I bow down to Rāma gone to the forest fastness.

sa: नहि राज्ञः सुताः सर्वे राज्ये तिष्ठन्ति भामिनि। स्थाप्यमानेषु सर्वेषु सुमहाननयो भवेत्॥
en: O emotional one, surely all the sons of the king do not obtain the kingdom. And if all were placed on the throne, mighty would be the disturbance therefrom.

sa: अब्रवीत् सुमहातेजा ब्रह्मा सुरुचिरं वचः। ऋषिस्त्वमसि भद्रं ते स्वार्चितैः कर्मभिः शुभैः॥
en: The exceedingly effulgent Brahmă addressed him in soothing words, saying, “You are henceforth a saint, good to you, and (this. eminence) you have attained through your own laudable exertions.'

sa: सुग्रीवप्रियकामेन यदहं निहतस्त्वया। मामेव यदि पूर्वं त्वमेतदर्थमचोदयः। मैथिलीमहमेकाह्वा तव चानीतवान्भवः ॥ राक्षसं च दुरात्मानं तव भार्यापहारिणम्। कण्ठे बद्ध्वा प्रदद्यां तेऽनिहतं रावणं रणे।।५०
en: I have been killed by you, desirous of encompassing Sugrīva's well being. Hadst you apprized me of your object before, I would have got you your Maithili in the course of a day, and brought, by the neck, that vicious-souled Raks asa-Rāvaņa, the ravisher of your spouse with out putting an end to his life in the battle.

sa: त्वं राजा भरत भव स्वयं नराणां वन्यानामहमपि राजराणमृगाणाम्। गच्छ त्वं पुरवरमद्य सम्प्रहृष्टः संहृष्टस्त्वहमपिदण्डकान् प्रवेक्ष्ये॥
en: O Bharata, be you yourself the monarch of men. I shall become the king of kings of deer. Go you to that foremost of cities with a glad heart: with a glad heart will I enter Dandaka.

sa: एवं राजर्षयः सर्वे प्रतीता रघुनन्दन। तस्मात् त्राहि नरश्रेष्ठ पितरं नरकात् प्रभो॥
en: O son of the Raghu race, the Rājarşis have delivered their decision on the point. Therefore, you foremost of men, do you, O lord, rescue your sire from hell.

sa: गतिं खर इवाश्वस्य तार्थ्यस्येव पतत्त्रिणः। अनुगन्तुं न शक्तिर्मे गतिं तव महीपते॥
en: As a mule is incapable of imitating the course of a horse, or as birds, that of Tarksya, I, O Lord of earth, lack the strength to imitate you.

sa: बादमित्यब्रवीद् र.ना मुनिश्च समभाषत। लीलया स धनुर्मध्ये जग्राह वचनान्मुनेः॥ पश्यतां नृसहस्राणां बहूनां रघुनन्दनः। आरोपयत् स धर्मात्मा सलीलमिव तद्धनुः॥ आरोपयित्वा मौर्वी च पूरयामास तद्धनुः। तद् बभञ्ज धनुर्मध्ये नरश्रेष्ठो महायशाः॥ तस्य शब्दो महानासीनिर्घातसमनिःस्वनः। भूमिकम्पश्च सुमहान् पर्वतस्येव दीर्यतः॥ निपेतुश्च नराः सर्वे तेन शब्देन मोहिताः। वर्जयित्वा मुनिवरं राजानं तौ च राघवौ॥
en: Thereat both the king and the ascetic said, Excellent well. At the words of the anchorite, in the sight of countless thousands of spectators, the righteous son of Raghu with exceeding ease took hold of the bow by the middle, and fixed the string upon it, and having fixed the string, drew it. And that foremost of men enjoying high fame, snapped the bow in the middle. And mighty was the sound that was heard on the occasion, like to the bursting of a thunder-clap: and the earth trembled terribly, as it does in the vicinity of a mountain splitting; and overwhelmed by the noise, all rolled head over heels, with the exception of that best of ascetics, the king, and the two Rāghavas.

sa: किं करिष्याम्ययोध्यायां ताते दिष्टां गतिं गते। कस्तां राजवराद्धीनामयोध्यां पालयिष्यति॥ किं नु तस्य मया कार्यं दुर्जातेन महात्मनः। यो मृतो मम शोकेन स मया न च संस्कृतः॥
en: What shall I do with Ayodhyā, my sire having gone the way ordained by the gods? And who will govern her, now that she has been deprived of that foremost of monarchs? Of fruitless birth that I am, what can I do for that magnanimous one? And of him that renounced his life from grief on my account I have not even performed the last rites.

sa: अलं वत्से रुदित्वा ते न भेतव्यं च सर्वशः॥ दानमानप्रसादैस्त्वां तोषयिष्यामि यत्नतः।
en: Of no avail is your lamentation, dear sister; you need not be afraid of any of your of relatives. I shall please you studiously by gifts, honours and favours.

sa: त्वामेव मार्गमाणौ तौ विचरन्तौ वसुंधराम्॥ ददर्शतुर्मूगपतिं पूर्वजेनावरोपितम्। ऋष्यमूकस्य मूले तु बहुपादपसंकुले॥ भ्रातुर्भयार्तमासीनं सुग्रीवं प्रियदर्शनम्।
en: And ranging the earth for you they beheld Sugriva, of comely presence, the lord of monkeys, at the foot of the mount Rsyamūka covered with trees, banished by his elder brother and resorting there in his fear.

sa: तव नाशं च वैदेहि वालिनश्च तथा वधम्॥ प्रायोपवेशमस्माकं मरणं च जटायुषः। तेषां नः स्वामिसंदेशानिराशानां मुमूर्षताम्॥ कार्यहेतोरिहायातः शकुनिर्वीर्यवान् महान्। गृध्रराजस्य सोदर्यः सम्पातिर्नाम गृध्रराट्॥
en: O Vaidehī, mentioning your rape, the destruction of Vāli in that way, our fastings and Jatayu's death. While we were thus waiting, ready for death and giving up all hopes for the fulfilment of our master's behest, there appeared, as if the cause of our success, the mighty and powerful vulture, the brother of Jațãyu, by name Sampati.

sa: दिष्ट्या हि न मम व्यर्थं सागरस्येह लङ्घनम्॥ प्राप्स्याम्यहमिदं देवि त्वद्दर्शनकृतं यशः।
en: By my good fortune, my crossing over the main, has not become fruitless. I shall be praised there, O worshipful dame, for I have been able to see you.

sa: मत्कृते काकमात्रेऽपि ब्रह्मास्त्रं समुदीरितम्। कस्माद् यो माहरत् त्वत्तः क्षमसे तं महीपते॥
en: You hadston my behalf discharged the Brahma weapon even at a crow. Why then, O lord of earth, do you forbear him who had carried me off from you?

sa: ईदृग्विधैस्तु हरिभिर्वृतो दन्तनखायुधैः। शतैः शतसहस्रश्च कोटिभिश्चायुतैरपि॥ आगमिष्यति सुग्रीवः सर्वेषां वो निषूदनः।
en: Surrounded with monkeys of this sort, having nails and teeth for their arms, in hundreds and thousands and koțis and ayutas, come our Sugrīva, the slayer of all (foes).

sa: ततः कपि तं प्रसमीक्ष्य गर्वितं जितश्रमं शत्रुपराजयोचितम्। अवैक्षताक्ष: समुदीर्णमानसं सबाणपाणिः प्रगृहीतकार्मुकः॥
en: And finding the monkey proud and untiring, capable of vanquishing his foe, and possessed of exalted spirits, Akșa took up his bow and held his arrows in his hands.

sa: स तस्य तानष्ट वरान् महाहयान् समाहितान्भारसहान् विवर्तने। जघान वीरः पथि वायुसेविते तलप्रहारैः पवनात्मजः कपिः॥
en: And remaining in the path coursed by the air, that heroic monkey, the offspring of the Windgod, with his slaps slew his eight powerful and excellent steeds, capable of bearing pressure and trained to diverse circular movements.

sa: कपिना कृष्यमाणानि महाभ्राणि चकाशिरे। प्रविशन्नभ्रजालानि निष्पतंश्च पुनः पुनः॥ प्रावृषीन्दुरिवाभाति निष्पतन् प्रविशंस्तथा!
en: Again and again entering into the clouds and emerging out of them, he resembled the Moon during the rains now entering into clouds) and now issuing out of them.

sa: तं तु मन्दोदरीपुत्रं कुमारं रणपण्डितम्॥ सहसा खं समुद्यन्तं पादयोश्च गृहीतवान्। तमासीनं शतगुणं भ्रामयित्वा व्यपेषयम्॥
en: No sooner the princely son of Mandodarī, versed in the art of war, rose high up in the welkin than I got hold of his legs and whirling him for hundred times ground him to the dust.

sa: तांस्तु दृष्ट्वा दशग्रीव ऊर्ध्वरोमा बभूव ह॥ स्वयभूवा दत्तवरस्ततः शीघ्र विनिर्ययौ। अथापश्यत्परं तत्र पुरुषं शयने स्थितम्॥ पाण्डुरेण महार्हेण शयनासनवेश्मना। शेते स पुरुषस्तत्र पावकेनावगुण्ठितः॥ दिव्यस्रगनुलेपा च दिव्याभरणभूषिता। दिव्याम्बरधरा साध्वी त्रैलोक्यस्यैकभूषणम्॥ वालव्यजनहस्ता च देवी तत्र व्यवस्थिता। लक्ष्मी देवी सपद्मा वै भ्राजते लोकसुन्दरी॥
en: Beholding them the down of the Ten-necked demon stood erect though a boon had been conferred upon him by the Self-born and he speedily issued out of that place. And he again saw another huge person lying down on a bed. His house, seat and bed were all white and valuable and he was sleeping enveloped by fire. And there sat gracefully with a fan in her lotus hands, the goddess Laksmī, most beautiful in the three worlds, (as if) the ornament thereof, chaste, adorned with celestial garlands, sprinkled with excellent sandal paste, be-decked with rich ornaments and clad in a precious raiment.

sa: कथंचिद् भवती दृष्टा न कालः परिशोचितुम्॥ इदं मुहूर्तं दु:खानामन्तं द्रक्ष्यसि भामिनि।
en: It dose not behove you to relent any more as I have succeeded in finding you out. You shall at this very moment behold the end of your grief.

sa: मान्या गुरुविनीतस्य लक्ष्मणस्य गुरुप्रिया। यदि सीता हि दुःखार्ता कालो हि दुरतिक्रमः॥
en: No one can withstand the course of destiny since Sītā, being the spouse of the worshipful brother of Laksmana, ever obedient to his elders, has been overwhelmed with grief.

sa: अतीव कामसंपन्नो वैदेहीमनुचिन्तयन्। अतीतसमये काले तस्मिन्वै युधि रावणः। अमात्यैश्च सुहृद्भिश्च प्राप्तकालममन्यत॥
en: The occasion for war was (wanting Rāvana, possessed by lust, and continually thinking of Vaidehī, conceived along with his counsellors that the time for entering into hostilities had arrived.

sa: राज्ञः पादौ गृहीत्वा तु राज्ञा ते प्रतिपूजिताः। पीठेष्वन्ये बृसीष्वन्ये भूमौ केचिदुपाविशन्॥
en: Taking the feet of the sovereign, and honoured by him (in turn), they sat them down, some-on raised seats, some on cushions of Kusa, and some on the floor.

sa: न चुक्रुशु नृतमाह कश्चित् सभासदो नापि जजल्पुरुच्चैः। संसिद्धार्थाः सर्व एवोग्रवीर्या भर्तुः सर्वे ददृशुश्चाननं ते॥
en: And no one among these present at court uttered any thing, or spoke any falsehood, or conversed in loud accents. And having completely attained their desire, all of fierce prowess, gazed at the face of their lord.

sa: अशक्यं सहसा राजन्भावो बोद्धं परस्य वै। अन्तरेण स्वरैभिन्नै पुण्यं पश्यतां भृशम्॥
en: Besides by a sudden questioning it is impossible to ascertain the intention of a foreigner. Do you therefore yourself accost him and determine, by his voice, his secret motive.

sa: जयस्व शत्रूनरदेव मेदिनी ससागरां पालय शाश्वतीः समाः। इतीव रागं नरदेवसत्कृतं शुभैर्वचोभिर्विविधैरपूजयत्॥
en: May you be victorious, O human-divine one! Rule you the Earth eternally! Thus in various auspicious words, did they pay homage to that one honoured by the Brāhmanas, Rāma.

sa: हा हतास्मि महाबाहो वीरव्रतमनुव्रत। इमां ते पश्चिमावस्थां गतास्मि विधवा कृता ॥
en: Ah! I am undone, O mighty-armed one! ) you that did follow stern vows! From your (death), I have come by this final plight, having been rendered a widow.

sa: दीर्घवृत्तभुजः श्रीमान्महोरस्कः प्रतापवान्। धन्वी संनहनोपेतो धर्मात्मा भुवि विश्रुतः॥ विक्रान्तो रक्षिता नित्यमात्मनश्च परस्य च। लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा कुलीनो नयशास्त्रवित्॥ हन्ता परबलौघानामचिन्त्यबलपौरुषः। न हतो राघवः श्रीमान्सीते शत्रुनिबर्हणः॥
en: And, possessed of arms long and rounded; graceful, broad-breasted; powerful; accoutred with the bow; and mailed; righteous; and famous over the earth; endowed with energy; and along with his brother, Lakşmaņa, ever protecting himself and others; of noble descent; and versed in polity; the destroyer of the hostile ranks; and of inconceivable strength and manhood, the graceful Răghava, O Sītā, slayer of foes, is not slain.

sa: किं वा वक्ष्यति वृद्धश्च जाम्बवानङ्गदश्च सः। गतं पारं समुद्रस्य वानराश्च समागताः॥
en: And what shall the aged Jambhavan, and what shall Angada, say? And what, again, shall the assembled monkeys say to me when I shall have crossed over the main.

sa: सा राक्षसानां प्रवरेण बाला स्वशीलसंरक्षणतत्परा सती। अनेन नूनं प्रति दुष्टकर्मणा हता भवेदार्यपथे परे स्थिता॥
en: That girl solicitous for the preservation of her chastity, and staying in the prime path of virtuous woman, that chaste one has, for certain, been slain by this chief of the Rākṣasas, (ever) finding delight in iniquity.

sa: न कालस्यातिभारोऽस्ति कृतान्तश्च सुदुर्जयः। यत्र रामः सह भ्रात्रा शेते युधि निपातितः॥
en: There is nothing which is too hard for Time; and the Destroyer is incapable of being overcome; inasmuch as Rāma along with his brother Lakşmaņa has fallen in fight.

sa: अवकाशो न साम्नस्तु राक्षसेप्वभिगम्यते। न दानस्य न भेदस्य नैव युद्धस्य दृश्यते॥
en: Opportunity find I none either for conciliation with the Raksasas, or for (winning them over) by gifts, or for sowing dissensions among them, or for conquering them in fight.

sa: ऋष्टिभिस्तोमरैश्चित्रैः श्लक्ष्णैश्च मुसलैरपि। भिन्दिपालैश्च चापैश्च शक्तिभिः पट्टिशैरपि॥ खङ्गैश्चक्रैर्गदाभिश्च निशितैश्च परश्वधैः। पदातयश्च नियन्ति विविधाः शस्त्रपाणयः॥
en: And equipped with slender swords and curious Tomaras and smooth maces and bhindipālas and bows and darts and pattiśa and scimitars and discuses and clubs and sharpened axes, the multiform infantry march bearing arms in their hands.

sa: ततस्तु रामस्य निशम्य वाक्यं विभीषणः शक्रसमानवीर्यः। शशंस रामस्य बलप्रवेकं महात्मनां राक्षसपुङ्गवानाम्॥
en: Then hearing Rama's speech, Vibhisana, possessed of the prowess of Sakra himself, informed Råma anent that foremost of hosts consisting of that flower of high souled Räkş asas, saying.

sa: वराभरणधारिण्यो निषण्णा ददृशे कपिः॥ वज्रवैदूर्यगर्भाणि श्रमणान्तेषु योषिताम्। ददर्श तापनायानि कुण्डलान्यङ्गदानि च॥
en: The monkey saw women bearing noble ornaments, lying down. And he saw golden bracelets and ear-rings at the nether ends of the women's ears, set with diamonds and lapises.

sa: अर्चिभिश्चापि रत्नानां तेजसा रावणस्य च। विरराज च तद् वेश्म रश्मिवानिव रश्मिभिः॥
en: On account of the lustre shed by the genes, as well as the energy of Rāvana himself, that mansion appeared splendid like the rayfurnished Sun in all his glory.

sa: तस्मिन्प्रवृत्ते तुमुले विमर्दे प्रहष्यमाणेषु वलीमुखेषु। निपात्यमानेषु च राक्षसेषु महर्षयो देवगणाश्च नेदुः॥
en: In that fearful conflict, which was being waged, on the monkeys having been exhilarated and the Rākşasas having been brought down, the Maharsis and the deities sent up shouts.

sa: स वेगवान्वेगवदभ्युपेत्य तं राक्षसं वानरवीरमुख्यः। संवर्त्य मुष्टिं सहसा जघान बाह्वन्तरे शैलनिकाशरूपः॥
en: Then impetuously approaching the Räks asas, that foremost of heroic monkeys resembling a hill, endowed with vehemence, clenching his fist, suddenly smote him with a blow on his breast.

sa: ततोऽस्य हारं चन्द्राभं मुच्य कण्ठात्स राघवः। वैदूर्यतरलं कण्ठे बबन्ध च हनूमतः॥
en: Having said this, Rāma took off from his neck a chain 'set with sapphires brilliant as the rays of the moon and placed it round the neck of Hanuman.

sa: यदहं गात्रसंस्पर्श गतास्मि विवशा प्रभो। कामकारो न मे तत्र दैवं तत्रापराध्यति॥
en: O lord, though my person was touched by another-but it was not in my power; nor was it an wilful act (of mine); accident is to blame in this.

sa: तमुवाच ततो रामो लक्ष्मणं शुभलक्षणम्। नैकस्य हेतो रक्षांसि पृथिव्यां हन्तुमर्हसि ॥
en: Thereupon Rāma spoke to Lakşmaņa, gifted with auspicious . marks, saying.-"It does not behove you to clear all the Rākşasas off the earth for the folly of one individual.

sa: उक्तश्च दुर्गमः पार:कार्याणां राक्षस त्वया। कार्याणां कर्मणा पारं यो गच्छति स बुद्धिमान्॥ स त्वमर्थस्य हीनार्थो दुरवापस्य केनचित्। वाचा व्याहृत्य जानीषे कृतार्थोऽस्मीति दुर्मते॥
en: O Rākşasa, hard is the achievement of the task that you have mentioned. He that compass business by act is alone intelligent. He that compass business by act is alone intelligent. But you, O wicked-minded one, incompetent as you are to bring about your end, attaining your arduous aim by words only, deem yourself as crowned with success.

sa: तदसुकरमथाभिवीक्ष्य हृष्टाः प्रियसुहृदो युधि लक्ष्मणस्य कर्म। परममुपलभन्मनः प्रहर्ष विनिहतमिन्द्ररिपुं निशम्य देवाः।१४।।
en: Beholding that deed, difficult of being done, performed by their beloved friend, Laks mana, and hearing their foe, Indrajit, slain (in battle), the celestials attained the summit of joy.

sa: सा दुःखभारावनता यशस्विनी यशोधरा नाथमपश्यती सती। रुरोद सा बहिणनादिते वने महास्वने दुःखपरायणा सती ॥
en: Being sunk in grief and pressed down with the weight of sorrow on not beholding Rāma, the foremost of the illustrious, the chaste Şītā began to cry aloud in the forest resounded with the notes of peacocks.

sa: भगदत्तो महाराज वृद्धस्तव पितुः सखा। स वाचा प्रणतस्तस्य कर्मणा च विशेषतः॥
en: O great king, who is called Bhagadatta and who was your father's old friend, has also lowered his head (to Jarasandha) by his speech and specially by his acts.

sa: ततोऽस्य भरतत्वम्। भरतः खलु काशेयीमुपयेमे सार्वसेनी सुनन्दा नाम। तस्यामस्य जज्ञे भुमन्युः॥
en: It is for this reason he was called Bharata. Bharata married Sunanda, the daughter of Sarvasena, the king of Kashi and she gave birth to a son, called Bhumanyu.

sa: तौ तु पीत्वा वरं पानं मदरक्तान्तलोचनौ। दृष्ट्वैव तां वरारोहां व्यथितौ सम्बभूवतुः॥
en: They were intoxicated with a large quantity of liquor and their eyes had grown red. As soon as they saw that most beautiful damsel, they were filled with desire.

sa: कालो वैनं विहरति क्रोधो वैनं हरत्युत। मैवं जीर्णमुपास्स्व त्वं सत्यं भवत्वपाकृधि॥
en: Do not, therefore, stick to that worn-out friendship. Do not think of it any longer. O best of Brahmanas, the friendship I entertained for you was for a particular.

sa: जज्ञे च यमुनाद्वीपे पाराशर्यः स वीर्यवान्। स मातरमनुज्ञाप्य तपस्येव मनो दधे॥
en: She gave birth on an island in the Yamuna, a greatly powerful child, begotten on her by Parashara; and the child with the permission of her mother adopted asceticism.

sa: शर्मिष्ठोवाच यदुक्तमृषिरित्येव तत् सत्यं चारुहासिनि। न्यायतो धर्मतश्चैव चरन्ती न बिभेमि ते॥
en: Sharmishtha said: O lady of sweet smiles! all that I told you about the Rishi is quite true. My acts were according to the precepts of virtue and right.

sa: तुरगा इव तत्रान्ये हस्तिहस्ता इवापरे। मत्ता इव च मातङ्गा महाकाया महाबलाः॥
en: Amongst those that perished, there were some that were like the horses, some like the trunks of elephants and others with the huge bodies and strength of mad elephants.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा भीमसेनोऽत्यमर्षणः। निष्पिष्यैनं बलाद् भूमौ पशुमारममारयत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : having heard these words (of Arjuna) Bhimasena was inflamed with rage; and dashing him on the ground with all his might, he killed him like beast.

sa: न तत्कारणमल्यं वै धर्मज्ञा यत्र पाण्डवाः। अवध्यान्सर्वशो जघ्नुः प्रशस्यन्ते च मानवैः॥
en: It could not be a trifling cause for which the virtuous Pandavas killed those whom they should not have killed and for which they are still praised by men.

sa: इदं तु वचनं सौम्य कार्यं चैव निबोध मे। कौमारिकाणां शीलेन वक्ष्याम्यहमिरन्दम॥
en: O Gentle Sir, there is something else to be said and something else to be done. O chastiser of foes, those that have daughter must say what I say.

sa: याजकैः शुक्लवासोभिहूयमाना हुताशनाः। अगच्छन्नग्रतस्तस्य दीप्यमानाः स्वलंकृताः॥ ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्याः शूद्राश्चैव सहस्रशः। रुदन्तः शोकसंतप्ता अनुजग्मुर्नराधिपम्॥
en: The priests clad in white, walked in the van of the procession, pouring libations of ghee on the sacred fire, blazing in an ornamental vessel. Thousands of Brahmanas, Kshatriyas Vaishyas and followed the king, weeping in grief.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच स्वयंवरः क्षत्रियाणां विवाहः पुरुषर्षभः। स च संशयितः पार्थ स्वभावस्यानिमित्ततः॥
en: Krishna said: O best of men, Svyaimvara is the marriage form of the Kshatriyas, but, O Partha, that is doubtful, as we do not know her temper and disposition.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः प्रतीपो राजाऽऽसीत् सर्वभूतहितः सदा। निषसाद समा बह्वीर्गङ्गाद्वारगतो जपन्॥
en: Vaishampayana said: There was a king, named Pratipa, engaged in doing good to all creatures. He spent many years in ascetic penances, going to the source of (the river)Ganga.

sa: ययातिरुवाच अनिकेतो गृहस्थेषु कामवृत्तेषु संयतः। ग्राम एव वसन् भिक्षुस्तयोः पूर्वतरं गतः॥
en: Yayati said : He who is a man of knowledge and who is self controlled, though living among the householders with various sorts of desires, attains to salvation first.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तास्ततः सर्वे भ्रातरो विपुलौजसः। वार्ष्णेयः पाण्डवेयौ च प्रतस्थुर्मागधं प्रति॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having been thus addressed (by Yudhishthira) all the three brothers, the two Pandavas and the Varshneya (Krishna), all possessing great prowess, started for the kingdom of Magadha.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच मद्यैव पुण्याहमुत वः पाण्डवेया अद्य पौष्यं योगमुपैति चन्द्रमाः पाणिं कृष्णायास्त्वं गृहाणाद्य पूर्वम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : The illustrious Rishi then spoke thus to Dharamraja (Yudhishthira), "O son of Pandu today is an auspicious day. Today the Moon has entered the constellation Paushya. You first take the hand of Krishna today.”

sa: आस्तीक उवाच वरं ददासि चेन्मह्यं वृणोमि जनमेजय। सनं ते विरमत्वेतन्न पतेयुरिहोरगाः॥
en: Astika said: O Janamejaya, if you will at all to grant me a boon, let your this sacrifice be stopped and let no more snakes fall into the fire.

sa: ययाचे कुण्डले वीरं कवचं च सहाङ्गजम्। उत्कृत्य कर्णो ह्यददत्कवचं कुण्डले तथा॥
en: Begged from him his ear-rings and his natural coat of arms. Removing the ear-rings and coat of arms from his ear and breast, he gave them to him (Indra).

sa: विक्रमं मे यथेन्द्रस्य साद्य द्रक्ष्यसि शोभने। मावमंस्थाः पृथुश्रोणि मत्वा मामिह मानुषम्॥
en: O beautiful girl, you shall see to day my Indra like prowess. O lady of fair hips, do not consider me weak, thinking that I am a human being.

sa: दितेः पुत्रस्तु यो राजन्हिरण्यकशिपुः स्मृतः। स जज्ञे मानुषे लोके शिशुपालो नरर्षभः॥
en: O king, that son of Diti, who was known by the name of Hiranyakashipu, became (that king) who was known in this world by the name of powerful Shishupala.

sa: देवयान्युवाच सर्व एव नरश्रेष्ठ विधानमनुवर्तते। विधानविहितं मत्वा मा विचित्राः कथा: कृथाः॥
en: Devayani said : O best of kings, everything comes to pass according to Fate. Do not be astonished at this. V:10w it to be also the result of Fate.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः पुत्रशतं जज्ञे गान्धार्यां जनमेजय। धृतराष्ट्रस्य वैश्यायामेकश्चापि शतात् परः॥
en: Vaishampayana said: O Janamejaya, one hundred sons of Dhritarashtra were born in the womb of Gandhari. Besides these one hundred sons, one more was born by a Vaishya wife.

sa: व्यचरद् यमुनातीरे मृगयां स महायशाः। मृगान् विध्यन् वराहांश्च रेमे सार्धं किरीटिना॥
en: That greatly illustrious hero roamed along the banks of Yamuna in search of deer. he sported and hunted with Kiriti (Arjuna), piercing deer and wild boars with his arrows.

sa: रसं पिबेत् कुमारोऽयं त्वयि प्रीते महाबलः। बलं नागसहस्रस्य यस्मिन् कुण्डे प्रतिष्ठितम्॥
en: was saw When you are pleased, let this greatly powerful prince drink (of the vessel of) Rasa (ambrosia), in which vessel there is the strength of one thousand elephants.

sa: स्वैरेष्वपि न तेनाहं स्मरामि वितथं वचः। उक्तपूर्वं कुतो राजन्सांपराये स वक्ष्यति॥
en: I do not remember him to have spoken a falsehood even in jest. O king, why should he then speak a falsehood in such a serious matters. He said,

sa: एतावन्मे विदितं राजसिंह ततो भ्रष्टोऽहं नन्दनात् क्षीणपुण्यः। वाचोऽश्रौषं चान्तरिक्षे सुराणां सानुक्रोशाः शोचतां मां नरेन्द्र॥
en: O best of kings, this much I remember that I fell from Nandana and all my religious merits were gone. O king of men, I heard the voices of the celestials in the sky exclaiming in grief.

sa: गरुड उवाच एतामपि निषादी त्वं परिगृह्याशु निष्पत। तूर्णं संभावयात्मानमजीर्णं मम तेजसा॥
en: Garuda said: Take the Nishada woman with you and come out at once. Save yourself without delay for you are not yet digested by the heat of my stomach.

sa: विव्यासैकं चतुर्धा यो वेदं वेदविदां वरः। परावरज्ञो ब्रह्मर्षिः कविः सत्यव्रतः शुचिः॥
en: The best of the best Veda-knowing men first divided the Vedas into four parts. He was a great Brahma-knowing Rishi, a great poet, a truthful man, a holy ascetic.

sa: अतिथीनागतान् साधून् वृद्धान् बालांस्तथा गुरून्। पूजयन्त्या यथान्यायं शश्वद् गच्छन्तु ते समाः॥
en: Let your time be ever passed in duly entertaining your guests, the strangers that come to your house, the pious men, the old men, the children and the superiors.

sa: मया तु शममास्थाय यच्छक्यं कर्तुमद्य वै। तत्करिष्याम्यहं तात प्रेषयिष्ये नृपाय वै॥
en: O my son, having adopted peacefulness, I shall do as much as lies in my power. I shall do this. I shall send word to the king, telling him,

sa: कस्य त्वमसि का चासि किं च भीरु चिकीर्षसि। साब्रवीद् दाशकन्यास्मि धर्मार्थं वाहये तरिम्॥ पितुर्नियोगाद् भद्रं ते दाशराज्ञो महात्मनः। रूपमाधुर्यगन्धैस्तां संयुक्तां देवरूपिणीम्॥ समीक्ष्य राजा दाशेयी कामयामास शान्तनुः। स गत्वा पितरं तस्या वरयामास तां तदा॥
en: Having seen her, he asked that black-eyed maiden, "O timid maiden, who are you? What are you doing here?” She said, “Blessing be upon you! I am the daughter of the chief of the fishermen. By the command of my father I am engaged to row this boat of take people across this river for religious merits.” Having seen her endued with celestial beauty, amiableness and fragrance, the king Shantanu desired to possess her. He went to her father and asked him to bestow her upon him.

sa: यदाश्रौषं मागधानां वरिष्ठं जरासन्धं क्षत्रमध्ये ज्वलन्तम्। दोा हतं भीमसेनेन गत्वा तदा नाशंसे विजयाय संजय॥
en: I had no hope of success, O Sanjaya, when I heard that the foremost king of the Magadha dynasty, the shining star of all the Kshatriyas Jarasandha had been killed by Bhima alone with his bare arms.

sa: अथ दीर्घस्य कालस्य राजा पूरुमथाब्रवीत्। आनयस्व जरां पुत्र न्यासं निर्यातयस्व मे॥
en: Thereupon after a long time Yayāti said to Puru O my son, do you bring the decrepitude I have kept as deposit with you, let it now assail me.

sa: देवयान्युवाच त्वरितं घूर्णिके गच्छ शीघ्रमाचक्ष्व मे पितुः॥ नेदानीं सम्प्रवेक्ष्यामि नगरं वृषपर्वणः।
en: Devayani said : O Ghurnika, go speedily to my father and tell him as soon as possible all that had happened. I shall not enter the city of Vrishaparva.

sa: राक्षसस्त्वं मया जातः क्षत्ररूपो दुरासदः। प्रतिहसि ममाज्ञां त्वं प्रजार्थे विफलो भव॥
en: You, vicious Rākhasa, are born of me in the shape of a Kşatriya, or else why should you disobey my orders? For this you shall never be a king.

sa: न ह्यर्हत्येष सम्मानं नापि वृद्धक्रमं गुणैः। हन्मैनं सह पुत्रेण दुराचारं नृपद्विषम्॥
en: He does not deserve our respect or he veneration due to his age. On account of such conduct, we shall kill this wretch who insult kings with their sons.

sa: खनकेन तु तेनैव वेश्म शोधयता बिलम्। पांसुभिः पिहितं तच्च पुरुषैस्तैर्न लक्षितम्॥
en: The miner, while removing the ashes, covered with it the hole he had dug in such a way that it remained unnoticed by all who had gone there. to

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तस्मै दित्सति कन्यां तु ब्राह्मणाय तदा नृपे। कोप आसीन्महीपानामालोक्यान्योन्यमन्तिकात्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : When the king expressed his desire to bestow his daughter on that Brahmana, all the assembled kings looked at one another and were filled with wrath.

sa: निवेद्य रामस्य पुनर्निर्जगाम नृपालयात्। वक्तव्यं यदि ते किंचित्तत्त्वं ब्रूहि नृपाय वै॥
en: And having communicated it to Rāma he issued out and said to the dog:-"If you have anything true to speak you may come and communicate it to the king."

sa: व्यास उवाच पुरा वै नैमिषारण्ये देवाः सत्रमुपासते। तत्र वैवस्वतो राजशामित्रमकरोत् तदा॥
en: Vyasa said : In days of yore, the celestials performed a great sacrifice in the Naimisha forest. O king, the son of Vivasvata (Yama) became the slayer of animals.

sa: ततोऽब्रुवन् लोकगुरुं समेता भयात् तीव्रान्मानुषाणां च वृद्ध्या। तस्माद् भयादुद्विजन्तः सुखेप्सवः प्रयाम सर्वं शरणं भवन्तम्॥
en: Alarmed at the increase on human beings, they all thus addressed the master of creation. “We are afflicted with the fear (of the increase of human beings) and therefore wishing to be relieved, we ask your protection.

sa: यदा त्वभ्येत्य पितरं सा वै राजीवलोचना। कंसभार्या जरासंधं दुहिता मागधं नृपम्। चोदयत्येव राजेन्द्र पतिव्यसनदुःखिता॥ पतिनं मे जहीत्येवं पुनः पुनररिंदम। ततो वयं महाराज तं मन्त्रं पूर्वमन्त्रितम्॥
en: But when the wife of Kansa and the daughter of Jarasandha, that lotus-eyed lady (Prapti) went to her father lamenting for the death of her husband, and when, O king, she again and again urged the king of Magadha, saying, “O chastiser of foes, kill the murderer of my husband," then, O great king, we thought of acting according to the conclusion we came to before.

sa: ततः कृतज्ञं धर्मज्ञं रूपेणासदृशं भुवि। तपत्याः सदृशं मेने सूर्यः संवरणं पतिम्॥
en: Thereupon Surya, seeing Samvarana, learned in the precepts of region and matchless in the world for his beauty, considered him to be the fittest husband for (his daughter) Tapati.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच धृतराष्ट्राभ्यनुज्ञातः स्वबाहुविजितं धनम्। भीष्माय सत्यवत्यै च मात्रे चोपजहार सः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : He (Pandu), at the command of Dhritarashtra, offered the wealth acquired by the prowess of his arms of Bhishma, to Satyavati and to their mother (Kausalya).

sa: तयोरागमनं ज्ञात्वा वरदानं च तत् प्रभोः। हित्वा त्रिविष्टपं जग्मुर्ब्रह्मलोकं ततः सुराः॥
en: Learning that they were coming and knowing also what boons they had obtained from the Supreme Lord, the celestials left heaven and sought refuge in the region of Brahma.

sa: न त्वमर्हसि पार्थेन सूतपुत्र रणे वधम्। कुलस्य सदृशस्तूर्णं प्रतोदो गृह्यतां त्वया॥
en: O Charioteer's son, you deserve no to be killed by Partha in the battle. You should better take up the whip (instead of the sword) which befits your race.
